description: Which licences the packages Nuvrion installs may carry. Checked in CI by tools/evaluate-licenses.js; a package that is not accepted fails the build.

reviewed.reason: The noVNC client library, served to the browser unmodified from node_modules (apps/api/src/server.js, /vendor/novnc). MPL-2.0 is a file-level copyleft: it applies to those files, which are not changed here, and their licence headers are served intact. It is linked by the console as a separate script, not merged into Nuvrion's own files.
Accessibility test engine used only by the browser tests (a development dependency); it is not part of the image or of any release.
A static analysis rule used only in CI (tools/static-analysis); it is not part of the image or of any release.

declared.source: The package's own package.json declares MIT in the legacy `licenses` array (the registry metadata has no `license` field) and its tarball carries the MIT text in LICENSE. Read on 2026-10-15. An optional build helper of ssh2.

The package's own package.json declares MIT in the legacy `licenses` array (no `license` field), its LICENSE is the MIT text, and it bundles Google's cpu_features library under deps/cpu_features with its own Apache-2.0 LICENSE. Read on 2026-10-15. An optional native helper of ssh2.
